scene_sentence_zh: 陡峭的山道沿著岩壁盤旋而上，碎石在腳下滾落，空氣中帶著岩石與松脂的氣味。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a narrow winding mountain track of grey scree climbing across a rock ledge on a steep cliff face, loose stones and boulders piled at the trail's edge, a sheer crag rising on one side and an open drop on the other, jagged peaks and a distant valley half-veiled in drifting mist beyond the ridge, a few wind-bent pines clinging to the rock, cold grey stone in slanting morning light, an unobstructed open rocky foreground

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: a painterly JRPG mountain track climbing a rock ledge, with an unobstructed lower foreground for stage figures, no interface, watermark or readable lettering, and no town/forest reuse.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop (browser method web.tests.browser.test_browser_bundled_scene_assets.BundledSceneAssetsBrowserTest.test_outdoor_pack_static_decode): the full-bleed composition holds and the illustration stays distinguishable from its siblings at that viewport.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed as a three-up contact sheet beside wilderness_path and coastal_path: scene identity, palette and composition are distinct for every sibling.
